name: Definable.image_comp
statement: Set (β → M)} (h : A.Definable L s) (f : α → β) [Finite α] [Finite β] : A.Definable L ((fun g : β → M => g ∘ f) '' s)

name: DefinableFun.comp
statement: (β → M) → α → M} (hg : A.DefinableMap L g) (hf : A.DefinableFun L f) : A.DefinableFun L fun v => f (g v)

name: DefinableFun.ite
statement: (α → M) → Prop} {g} [DecidablePred p] (hp : A.Definable L (setOf p)) (hf : DefinableFun L A f) (hg : DefinableFun L A g) : DefinableFun L A fun v => if p v then f v else g v
